stage: Exploratory follow-up after the veto-versus-refit audit showed excess vetoes on common proposals. Same previously inspected 42 PMLB folds. This protocol is fixed before testing the challenger; earlier benchmark outcomes have been seen.
question: Can a single actual refit rescue a deletion beyond a separating-vote stopping point, and does the weakest-context vote choose a better column to drop than a Gain tie-break alone?
rule: Use the disjoint train/proposal/guard splits, reference A, and separating terminal support S from the refit-guard study. If |S|>1 tentatively remove exactly one of its columns. For each candidate T=S minus one column, evaluate the minimum count of yes votes across the same full restoration family against the SAME fixed anchor A. Choose the candidate with maximum worst-context count; ties remove the weakest original Gain feature. Evaluate candidates weakest first, stopping evaluation of any candidate whose current minimum cannot beat the incumbent. Verify against exhaustive candidate-by-context computation. Also compare the deletion of the weakest Gain column of S irrespective of votes. A singleton has no eligible challenger.
refit: Using common models fitted on train+proposal rows, compare each candidate T to A on the untouched inner guard under the refit-guard joint threshold. Select T if it passes; otherwise retain S if S passes; otherwise fall back to A. Use for both challengers the same guard, fit count policy and fallback. The final rule overrides the original veto only through an actual inner validation refit. The new algorithm is distinct from enforcing every masked veto.
outcomes: For both candidate-only supports and guarded choices: task-average external AUC, accuracy, fraction and count retained, folds switched, error-tolerance exceedances versus refitted A on the archived outer rows; width equality, candidate identity, nomination mask calls with and without pruning, and fitting/query costs. This one-step study does not optimize global support. No fitting to external labels or further tuning. Report a null or harmful outcome and do not promote this modification on that basis.
limit: One thread per estimator; one hour hard limit per fold; all folds are included.
